_comment: Block colours, strengths and propagation methods. Every .json file in assets/colorlight/block/ of every enabled resource pack is read, in alphabetical order of file name (a pack with a file of the same name replaces a lower pack's file). Later entries override earlier ones field by field. Entries here beat the texture scan and other mods' defaults, but never a block the player set by hand in ColorLight's GUI. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_keys: A block id ("minecraft:" may be left out), a block tag ("#minecraft:candles"), or a pattern with * and ? ("minecraft:*_lantern").
_other: "light": 1..15 (cap on the emitted level), "propagation": "colorlight:smooth" (how this block's light spreads), "enabled": false (no coloured light for the block). Everything is optional; what you leave out stays as it was.
_example: Example entry (delete the leading underscore of a key to use it): "_minecraft:torch": { "color": [255, 150, 60], "light": 14 }
